svg.title: Inside a tool-using AI agent
svg.desc: The model never touches the world directly. It plans, asks the runtime to call a tool, reads the result and decides again — inside guardrails, with memory on both sides.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Noto Sans SC, monospace
text.tspan: AGENT RUNTIME · LOOP UNTIL DONE OR BUDGET SPENT

text.tspan: Tools are just functions with a schema. The runtime
executes them; the model only proposes.
